title: actor.me, contract version 1
description: Who am I (PRD 5.16, 13.4): the principal's own actor with its class, state and version, its profile and the grants it holds. The document carries nothing: the actor is never a field of a query, so the pipeline takes it from the credential alone, and every actor may run it without a permission while the anonymous principal may not. The PHP form is Cbox\Cms\Core\Identity\Domain\Queries\WhoAmI, and the generated codec reads it and writes its canonical JSON: an object without members. Its result is actor.me.result.v1.json.
